graph.name: Aetion: Streamlined Application and Infrastructure Deployment with CodePipeline and CloudFormation
graph.categories: DevOps, CI/CD, Containers, Infrastructure as Code, Healthcare Analytics
graph.notes: Healthcare analytics company streamlines the path from developer commit to production. A pipeline runs CodeCommit (source), then CodeBuild (build container image, push to ECR), then CloudFormation (deploy stage). CloudFormation deploys the application and its infrastructure (ECS task definition, IAM role, ALB) into per-customer VPCs, with parallel stages for up to 100 customers from a single template. Governance is a three-step deploy: change set, approval, execute.

nodes.name: Developer
nodes.notes: Commits application code, build definitions and CloudFormation templates to the repository. Can change the build or the infrastructure on demand by modifying the repository (going back to the first stage).

nodes.name: CodePipeline
nodes.notes: Orchestrates the stages: source (CodeCommit), build (CodeBuild), deploy (CloudFormation). Moves each commit to the next stage automatically. Parallel deploy stages accommodate up to 100 customers.

nodes.name: CodeCommit
nodes.notes: AWS source repository. Holds the application code and the CloudFormation templates that define the entire application infrastructure.

nodes.name: CodeBuild
nodes.notes: Build stage. Spins up a container and is paid for only for the duration of the build. The build is controlled by the developer through the repository. On a successful build it outputs a container image to ECR.

nodes.name: CloudFormation
nodes.notes: Deploy stage, chosen over CodeDeploy, the ECS task definition deployer and Lambda because it also deploys the underlying infrastructure. One baseline template is used for all production environments, with a small per-customer configuration (VPC name, ECS cluster). Runs in parallel to up to 100 customer VPCs. Three-step process: 1) change set, 2) approve or reject by someone with the proper roles and permissions, 3) execute the change set.

nodes.name: ECR Registry
nodes.notes: Container registry that stores the built application image, ready to be deployed.

nodes.name: VPC
nodes.notes: Production environment. Each customer is deployed to a different VPC (up to 100), all receiving the same changes from the single template. Developer environments are kept separate from production and client QA environments.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Elastic Container Service task definition deployed by CloudFormation to run the application image. The cluster name comes from the per-customer configuration.

nodes.name: IAM
nodes.notes: IAM roles and permissions required by the application, deployed by CloudFormation.

nodes.name: ALB
nodes.notes: Application load balancer required by the application, deployed by CloudFormation.

edges.notes: Developer commits code changes to the CodeCommit repository.

At the end of a successful build, CodeBuild outputs the application container image to the ECR registry.
As soon as the build is done and the image is in the registry, the CloudFormation deploy stage is kicked off.

CloudFormation deploys the IAM role and permissions.
CloudFormation deploys the application load balancer.
